scope: Space removal invalidation, retained-size quality and duplicate worker lifecycle
behavior: Removed folders/large-file rows are purged independently of capped parent child index
Known removed estimates adjust visible ancestors and folded aggregate buckets
Unknown omitted extents rebuild conservative lower bounds; old overestimate is not relabeled as a lower bound
Affected omitted directories remain visible with known survivors and incomplete state
Successful manual moves invalidate old space cache; invalidation unlinks only owned regular single-link files
Cache reader is explicit nonblocking bounded 64 MiB and validates file identity; parent user symlinks are rejected for read/write/invalidation
Duplicate stop retains physical worker slot; repeated reopen requests queue only one replacement; cancelled late results do not publish
Duplicate search roots follow the model home rather than unrelated global home
validationBoundary: Small synthetic retained-tree models and blocked injected duplicate readers; cache files and links are owned temporary fixtures. No user tree scanned for duplicate acceptance.
limits: No new visible GUI or long-running real duplicate workload acceptance
Foundation FIFO baseline already returned promptly on this host; no historic cache hang is claimed
Lower-bound rebuild intentionally drops unidentifiable aggregate contributions and requires rescan for full totals
Directory/syscall cancellation cannot force immediate return; worker slot stays reserved
No race-free claim for cache namespace check/use
Restoration-to-space-model invalidation and selection size provenance remain separate audit items
No user files removed, root query, helper install, hardware writes or release
build: passed as part of full regression
